summary: Changing the SECURE_REFERRER_POLICY default to "same-origin" correctly implements the requested security hardening and matches Django's actual upstream change. The fix is minimal and appropriate; documentation/release-note updates would normally accompany it but are out of scope for this source-only diff.

issues.description: Diff includes a no-op edit to the SECURE_SSL_REDIRECT line (removed and re-added identical 'SECURE_SSL_REDIRECT = False'), adding noise without a functional change.

Behavioral default change: existing sites relying on Referer-based verification from cross-origin links could be affected, but this is the intended, documented trade-off and a backwards-incompatible note in release docs is the expected mitigation.
Settings reference docs and a release-note entry should mention the new default, though such doc files are outside the shown source diff.
